answer: Divergent-Seed Commitments: each agent periodically publishes a random nonce, then signs a state that must depend on that nonce via a ferrous-hardened key derivation. Honest agents harbor unique histories, so their next states diverge unpredictably. Clones sharing one seed must either synchronize (detectable as identical trajectories) or fork into inconsistent states. Under a rising tide of challenges, attackers must run one full instance per identity, paying compute, storage, and coordination costs linear in sybil count.
